verdict.rationale: gstack is a skill collection, so selective skill installation is a fair question. However, the evidence only describes a whole-bundle install: a "23 opinionated tools" package, a git-clone-and-copy install model, and a dev mode that symlinks the entire repo into .claude/skills/. Nothing documents choosing individual skills; the compressed agents-digest and per-project domain-skill promotion are adjacent features, not selective install.
